question: What is the meaning of instructions on removal of hazardous materials in relation to end-of-life data?
data_point: instructions on removal of hazardous materials
description: The instructions on removal of hazardous materials in relation to end-of-life data refer to the procedures and guidelines for safely disposing of hazardous materials at the end of a product's life cycle. This ensures compliance with environmental regulations and minimizes potential health and safety risks associated with improper disposal.
